about_the_game:
"Tie Me, Bind Me, Hit Me!" is a kinky take on the classic card game of Blackjack, or 21. Go head-to-head against opponents and try to get as close to 21 as you can without going bust, but watch out - In this version of Blackjack, 'Hit me' really does mean Hit me! Each time you draw a card you get hit, and whoever loses gets punished!

THE TOURNAMENT

Located in the middle of the ocean is Freyja's Rig. A once-simple oil rig, it was bought out by an unknown organization and converted into a private casino/auction house. There women come to enter the kinky "Tie Me, Bind Me, Hit Me!" tournament for the ultimate prize, but the ultimate risk: Having your one wish granted or losing your freedom to an audience member.

THE COMPETITORS

Experience the tournament through the 5 competitors - from a failed gothic rock singer to an ex-princess turned unemployed maid, each girl has their own backstory and selfish reasons for entering this tournament.

ALL ABOUT BDSM

  • 21 Kink Cards that alter the rules and make things more kinky in the match.

  • See different bondage positions as you progress through the tournament.

  • Win matches to earn points for unlockable costumes, mouth gags, card decks, etc.
